parsed.name: Seeed USB-CAN 分析仪
parsed.description: 用于通过 USB 将计算机连接到 CAN 总线的硬件接口设备，可完成总线初始化、状态查询与 CAN 报文发送，适合实验中的设备联调、协议通信和总线监测。
parsed.description_en: A hardware interface device that connects a computer to a CAN bus over USB. It supports bus initialization, status queries, and CAN message transmission for laboratory device integration, protocol communication, and bus monitoring.

actions.description: 关闭 USB-CAN 分析仪的串口通信接口。
actions.description_en: Close the USB-CAN analyzer serial communication interface.

actions.description: 发送初始化帧以配置设备并开始 CAN 通信。
actions.description_en: Send an initialization frame to configure the device and start CAN communication.

actions.description: 清空设备通信缓冲区以移除积压数据。
actions.description_en: Flush the device communication buffer to remove queued data.

actions.description: 发送状态查询帧以获取设备状态或错误信息。
actions.description_en: Send a status request frame to obtain device status or error information.

actions.description: 通过 USB-CAN 分析仪发送 CAN 报文。
actions.description_en: Send a CAN message through the USB-CAN analyzer.

actions.description: 获取底层通信接口的文件描述符。
actions.description_en: Get the file descriptor of the underlying communication interface.
